title: Affix
description: An item affix from the pool (03-GAME-DESIGN §6.2): a prefix or suffix with one roll range per grade band. One file per affix under content/affixes/<id>.json. Items carry rolled lines by affixId; the blacksmith can lock one and re-roll the rest.

name.description: The name fragment, e.g. 'of Vigor' or 'Keen'.

position.description: Where the fragment sits in the item's display name.

lines.description: One entry per grade band, non-overlapping, in ladder order. Each is either a stat roll (stat + unit + min/max) or an effect whose magnitude rolls min–max into the effect's amount or percent.

slots.description: Slots this affix can roll on.

weight.description: Roll weight in the pool, 1 rare – 5 common.

tags.description: Free grouping tags for the pool (offensive, defensive, element, gold …).

bandMin.description: Lowest item grade this line rolls on.

bandMax.description: Highest item grade this line rolls on.

stat.description: A derived stat or an attribute the line adds to.

unit.description: flat points or percent of the stat.

effect.description: An on-hit or passive effect line (element damage, a status chance, +gold found). Its amount/percent/chance is the rolled value.
